en.button.otherBusy: Another session is enhancing right now u2014 wait for it, or close its result panel first.
en.button.title: Enhance prompt (rewrite into a structured prompt)
en.error.concurrencyLimit: {max} enhancements are already running u2014 wait for one to finish, then retry.
en.error.disabled: Prompt enhance is disabled in the plugin settings.
en.error.empty: The input box is empty u2014 type a prompt to enhance first.
en.error.imagesOnly: Only images are attached; prompt enhance supports text only.
en.error.internal: Enhancement failed. Retry; your draft is untouched.
en.error.occurrences: The draft contains commands or file references, which are not supported yet u2014 remove them first.
en.error.phase: The input box is busy (submitting) u2014 try again in a moment.
en.error.rateLimit: Too many requests u2014 at most {limit} enhancements per minute; retry in {retryAfterSeconds} seconds.
en.error.timeout: The enhancement timed out ({seconds}s). Retry; your draft is untouched.
en.error.tooLong: The draft is {count} characters, above the {max} cap (Unicode characters, not tokens). It is never auto-truncated (that would change your meaning) u2014 please shorten it.
en.error.unconfigured: No model resolved for the enhancement: pair provider/model in the plugin settings, or send a message in the current session first (the enhancement will follow the session model).
en.error.upstream: The model provider returned an error. Retry; your draft is untouched.
en.error.upstream.auth: Authentication failed u2014 check the API key configured for this provider.
en.error.upstream.contextWindow: The input exceeds the model context window u2014 shorten it or switch models.
en.error.upstream.empty: The model returned an empty response; retry.
en.error.upstream.invalidCredential: Authentication failed u2014 the stored API key is invalid; fix it and retry.
en.error.upstream.maxTokens: The rewrite hit the output cap (maxOutputTokens) u2014 raise it in settings or shorten the draft.
en.error.upstream.quota: The model provider reports a quota/balance issue u2014 check your account.
en.error.upstream.rateLimit: The model provider is rate-limiting; retry later.
en.error.upstream.toolCall: The model requested tool calls, but prompt enhance needs plain text u2014 switch models and retry.
en.panel.loading.hint: Your draft stays untouched until you apply the result.
en.panel.stale.warn: The draft changed while enhancing u2014 the result is based on the pre-enhance text. Applying will overwrite your latest edits (undo restores the draft as it was before applying).
en.panel.title: Prompt Enhance
en.undo.applied: Original prompt replaced by the enhanced version
